title: Consolidated tiered rollout and customer rollback notes
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Produce coordinated internal and customer-facing release notes for the 2026.03 console/runtime uplift that (1) surface behavioral changes and upgrade actions, (2) include concise rollback instructions for tiered customers, and (3) provide a signoff matrix and localization plan. Deliverables: internal brief (exec summary + tech impact), customer changelog variants (public, enterprise tiered, and upgrade guide), short rollback runbook for customers (2-page PDF), and a localized QA checklist for translations. Acceptance criteria: legal and security clearance obtained, release notes validated by engineering for accuracy, localized strings validated in staging, and support playbook updated with rollback steps.
checklist: Draft internal brief and one-page tech notes - owner: PM
Create public-facing short changelog (<=300 words) - owner: PM/Docs
Produce enterprise tiered changelog with explicit upgrade/rollback steps - owner: Solutions Engineering
Build two-page customer rollback runbook (with CLI and Console steps) - owner: SRE
Legal redaction pass and privacy check - owner: Legal
Localization handoff and acceptance criteria (EN, FR, DE, JP) - owner: Localization
Signoff matrix completed (PM, Eng, SRE, Legal, Support, Sales) - owner: PM
Publish to customer portal and trigger email cohort for enterprise customers - owner: Growth/Comms
Post-launch monitoring dashboard and evaluation triggers (error spike > 5% OR latency +50ms) - owner: Observability
